info.name: Hotel Room Booking API
info.description:
Walks the hotel workflow: rooms, availability search with the stay price, booking, confirmation that releases rival requests, overlap protection, back-to-back stays, cancellation rules, closing a room, the calendar, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8108). Repeatable: it registers a fresh guest, creates a uniquely numbered suite and books dates about five months ahead.

exec: const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 864e5); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

item.name: Rooms free for the stay, with the price

exec: pm.test("The new suite is listed with three nights costed", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("roomId")); pm.expect(r.nights).to.eql(3); pm.expect(r.totalPrice).to.eql(36000); });

item.name: Fewer seats than guests hides the room
Check-in in the past is rejected
Too many guests for the room

exec: pm.test("Pending, three nights, 36,000 total", () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(b.nights).to.eql(3); pm.expect(b.totalPrice).to.eql(36000); pm.expect(b.number).to.match(/^HB-\d+$/); pm.expect(b.canCancel).to.be.true; });

item.name: The same guest cannot overlap their own booking
Another guest may ask for overlapping dates

exec: pm.test("Two, soonest check-in first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].checkIn <= l[1].checkIn).to.be.true; });

pm.test("Confirmed and the rival released", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("CONFIRMED"); pm.expect(b.confirmedBy).to.eql("hoteladmin"); pm.expect(b.autoCancelled).to.eql(1); });

item.name: The rival was released with a reason

exec: pm.test("Cancelled by the system", () => { const b = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("rivalId")); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(b.cancelledBy).to.eql("system"); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.include("another guest"); });

item.name: A released booking cannot be confirmed
The confirmed stay hides the room
A booking starting on the check-out day is allowed
A room with live bookings cannot be closed

pm.test("Visible", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("backToBackId")).cancelReason).to.eql("Pipe burst in the suite"));

item.name: A closed room cannot be booked
A closed room is hidden from searches

exec: pm.test("Rooms with days", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.days).to.be.at.least(28); pm.expect(c.rooms.length).to.be.at.least(1); });
